release: Pebble v1.5.0's frontend, frozen with capture/freeze-release.py and verified (tag commit 16dd425)
method: Pebble 1.5.0's frontend (the frozen v1.5.0 tree) driven by scripted host events and fixture timings: a re-enactment with sample data. Every clock the window prints is the recording's own.

spliced.why: the climax re-record (OVERRIDES §40): frames before the Run tests click stay the earlier take's

fidelity: From the Run tests click the climax follows v1.5.0's Ask-mode event model (OVERRIDES §40): the approved tests run inside the approve route, and Verified is the completion check on the resumed run's finished turn

send.what: the request is sent; the run starts (every +N s counts from here)

cards.what: the two edit cards arrive and the Details drawer opens on them

apply1_last_before.what: the invoice_kit/dates.py card waiting, the last frame before the click

apply1_click.what: Apply edit (dates.py); the app re-renders on this frame (the card moves to Earlier actions)

apply2_click.what: Apply edit (tests/test_dates.py), under the second question card

done_in_place.what: the drawer scroll settles: the dates.py card marked Done, Undo this edit where Apply edit was

done_still_until.what: the last frame on which Undo this edit and the drawer have not moved

notice.what: the reply ends with the host's 'Verification remains incomplete: …' notice

hold.what: verification_required: the drawer shows 'Pebble's change isn't verified yet.' with Run the tests, Ask Pebble to finish, Accept as unverified; the status line says Blocked

held_block_in_view.what: the person's scroll brings the conversation's held run (Blocked, the sentence, the three buttons) into view

held_settled.what: the scroll ends; the held run is static to the click

run_the_tests_last_before.what: the held run, the last frame before the click

run_the_tests_click.what: Run the tests (the held run's first button)

isolated_card.what: the 'Run isolated tests' card arrives in the drawer ('Runs the project's tests in a temporary copy. Your project files don't change.')

run_tests_last_before.what: the card waiting, the last frame before the click

run_tests_click.what: Run tests (App.vue decide() calls approve): the approve route starts the tests. The card leaves Needs your review and reads Running in Earlier actions, below the fold; no step, progress or run event while they run, and the status line keeps the review words

completion.what: the run completes (Done.), the host's idle follows on the same frame and the conversation re-reads: the reply moves after the host's summary. The app's own completion, for the one celebration

card_scroll_start.what: the person scrolls the drawer down to the card, now its last

card_running_in_view.what: the first frame with the Running card in the drawer's view

card_settled.what: the scroll ends: the Running card in view and still until the tests end

tests_running.what: the card reads Running on these 72 frames, exactly 2.4 s

tests_end.what: the tests end: the card reads Done and its Result block grows below the fold; the approve route answers, so 'Action completed' arrives (the second toast), and the conversation gets the host's summary; the run is queued and running again

summary_in_view.what: the conversation shows the host's 'The isolated test run finished with exit code 0. Review the output in Activity & review.'

result_scroll_start.what: the person scrolls down to the card's Result

result_in_view.what: the scroll ends: the Done card with Result (Outcome passed, Tests passed 42 …, Exit code 0) and the output '42 passed in 1.84s'

resumed_attempt.what: the resumed run: 'Recalled 3 memories', then 'Waiting for the model'; its text streams into the drawer's 'Receiving model response'

steps_scroll_start.what: the person scrolls back up to the newest steps

steps_in_view.what: the scroll ends: the newest steps, the run's state and the live response in view; the drawer is still from here to the end

model_responded.what: the model responded: the live response closes, and the reply's last paragraph arrives in the conversation in one piece

verified.what: 'Verified · pytest 42 passed on current files': the completion check on the finished turn

box: Pebble's change isn't verified yet. · 2 file(s) changed and no tests were run, but 1 test file(s) cover this code: ["tests/test_dates.py"]. Run them (RunTests) before finishing and report what they said. Details

section: The tests ran in an isolated copy of your project: **42 passed**. Both edits are verified, and the CSV export works again for invoices issued on the 29th,

step.text: Verified · pytest 42 passed on current files
